raw_response:
I will not put chemical fertilizer on this beans plot because I need to save my FISP coupons for the maize, and beans can fix their own nitrogen anyway. I will use manure that I have collected from my livestock to give the beans some strength. I will plant using seed I kept from last season because improved bean seed is hard to find and expensive here in Dowa. Weeding and harvesting will be done by my family since the plot is small, and I will not waste money on chemicals or irrigation when the rains are coming.
